content:
marta: Heads-up — PR #4012 is blocked by the `staging-smoke` job failing repeatedly on shard 3. Small backfill change, want to land before EOD if we can. Anyone available to poke?

buildkite-bot: buildkite: job `staging-smoke (shard=3)` failed on build 8738. 1 failing test: TestRuntimeKVStability. Logs: https://buildkite.company/8738 (truncated)

kyle: I can take a look. Which commit hash is the latest in the PR? Also is this a consistent failure or intermittent?

marta: Latest commit `7a9c2b1`. Failed twice in a row on shard 3 in the last hour. Another run earlier passed.

kyle: Skimming the logs — two different symptoms across runs: one looks like an OOM, another shows:
```
--- FAIL: TestRuntimeKVStability (0.32s)
    kv_test.go:214: expected key count 1024, got 1009
```
Could be nondet or a resource pressure issue.

jen: If it's flaky we usually do a targeted rerun first. If that passes twice we can merge and follow up with a flaky-test label. Can someone trigger a targeted rerun for shard 3? @sam? :eyes:  :thumbsup:

sam: On it — triggering a targeted rerun for build 8738 -> job staging-smoke shard=3. Command: `bk retry --job 8738 --shard 3`
sam: ✅ kicked off build 8743 (targeted-rerun, shard=3). I'll post back when it finishes.

buildkite-bot: build 8743 (staging-smoke shard=3) started by sam.

kyle: If the rerun passes, we should still consider adding a short-term mem bump or increase the shard timeout in the PR to reduce flakes. I'll open a small follow-up if we see recurrence.

marta: Cool. If rerun passes twice, can someone approve? I only have one approver so far.

jen: I can approve after the first green if there are no other blocking reviews. If it passes once, please ping me and I'll give LGTM.

buildkite-bot: build 8743 passed — staging-smoke shard=3.

sam: Rerun passed. Re-triggering once more to be safe (per our flaky-policy): `bk retry --job 8743 --shard 3` -> build 8751.

buildkite-bot: build 8751 passed.

jen: OK looks safe. @marta go ahead and merge after squashing the tiny change. Also please add `// flaky: true` comment on the test file and create a follow-up issue to investigate KV nondeterminism.

marta: Will do — merging now. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround :rocket:

kyle: Filing a follow-up ticket to track root cause and add a flaky tag to the test suite: https://triage.company/ISSUE-2147

sam: Noted — will monitor the next 24h CI window for regressions.

jen: Nice! Short and clean.
